nodes.title: Browser runtime, rendering pipeline, and execution models
nodes.coverageFocus: Navigation, resource loading, DOM/CSSOM, layout and paint, event loop, workers, memory, events, storage, HTTP, and compatibility

nodes.title: Component architecture, design systems, and state ownership
nodes.coverageFocus: Component contracts, state ownership, composition, design tokens, shared libraries, microfrontends, and feature boundaries
nodes.boundary: A component boundary is an ownership and contract decision, not merely a visual rectangle; avoid duplicated state, hidden coupling, and framework-driven fragmentation.

nodes.title: API integration, data fetching, client caching, and consistency
nodes.coverageFocus: API fit, fetching lifecycle, normalized caches, invalidation, optimistic updates, pagination, races, retries, auth, and BFF aggregation
nodes.boundary: Server data is not ordinary local UI state; define cache ownership, freshness, mutation semantics, and the authoritative source for every transition.

nodes.title: Rendering, routing, hydration, and application delivery
nodes.coverageFocus: CSR, SSR, static rendering, streaming, routing, code splitting, hydration, metadata, CDN delivery, and progressive enhancement
nodes.boundary: Rendering strategy is not a framework label; connect it to personalization, latency, cacheability, interactivity, SEO, and failure behavior.

nodes.title: Offline, realtime, collaboration, and media-rich interactions
nodes.coverageFocus: Service workers, local persistence, sync, realtime transports, collaboration, reconnection, uploads, media, and peer-to-peer boundaries
nodes.boundary: Offline and realtime are consistency problems, not transport features; distinguish durable data, ephemeral presence, local intent, and server authority.

nodes.title: Performance, responsiveness, resource loading, and Web Vitals
nodes.coverageFocus: Performance budgets, LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript cost, images, fonts, rendering, workers, priorities, and field/lab measurement
nodes.boundary: Do not optimize metric labels in isolation; identify the actual critical path, main-thread work, resource dependency, or layout instability causing user-visible delay.

nodes.title: Accessibility, internationalization, responsive design, and input modalities
nodes.coverageFocus: Semantic HTML, keyboard and focus, ARIA, screen readers, visual and motion access, responsive layouts, localization, RTL, and input diversity
nodes.boundary: Accessibility is a behavior and contract requirement, not a final audit; native semantics, focus, input, localization, and responsive layout must be designed together.

nodes.title: Security, privacy, authentication, and untrusted content
nodes.coverageFocus: XSS, CSRF, CSP, sessions, token storage, authorization boundaries, supply chain, telemetry privacy, clickjacking, redirects, and uploads
nodes.boundary: The browser is an untrusted client; UI hiding is not authorization, local storage is not a safe secret store, and sanitization is context-specific.

nodes.title: Testing, observability, compatibility, deployment, and evolution
nodes.coverageFocus: Test layers, visual and accessibility gates, error boundaries, client telemetry, feature flags, rollout, compatibility, migrations, and operational ownership
nodes.boundary: Passing unit tests does not establish user experience or production safety; distinguish behavior, visuals, accessibility, performance, compatibility, and telemetry.
